title: A reading of Le Tellier's cipher letter to Marca (BnF Baluze 103 f. 50, 26 April 1644)
description: Transcription, key and reading of the cipher in BnF Baluze 103 f. 50 (Le Tellier to Marca, 26 April 1644), with shuffled-key controls, a calibration on f. 171r and an independent AI cross-check. Made with AI (Claude; Codex for the second transcription). No person has checked the transcription.
